prose: Your dynamic Disney-Marvel decoders are back at it again to take another Moon Knight. Exploring the second episode, we'll reveal themes relating to the morphing of medical freedom into technocratic dictatorship, the hidden cult of the dark goddess, sky clock symbolism and the liminal space between languages.
The Marvelous Demystifiers are: Chance Garton, Gabriel (Slick Dissident), Gordan Hamil.
